name: Fête — Events Platform
description: A white, loud and joyful events site for Fête, where run clubs, supper clubs and hack nights get made and filled: an oversized golden-ratio headline in tight Inter, one magenta-to-amber flare, pill buttons and soft wide shadows under poster prints. Point at the hero's button and a circle opens out of it into a mood — a starlit warp, an electric colour wash, a sky of hearts — while a dozen live-typeset posters drift at their own depths. A pinned phone tells hosting in four scroll-driven screens (the page types itself, the guest list fills, the door count climbs, the photos arrive), a real invitation turns into a ticket, and the communities and categories directory sits under it — plus Discover (live filters and an RSVP sheet), Host (a three-step builder with a live phone preview that publishes), Pricing (a payout calculator) and a live brand guide.
designedFor: Event, ticketing, community and RSVP products
Consumer landing pages that want loud, oversized type with a light, airy surface
Story-led home pages with a scroll-pinned, scroll-scrubbed product walkthrough
Seeing hover-triggered reveals, live mockups and a working builder built as editor-controllable components
